name: TJ Woodwork Design
old_description: TJ Woodwork has supported designers, architects, contractors and homeowners with their custom design needs for many years.  We know the value of quality living and design TJ Woodwork has built a strong reputation for superior skilled craftsmanship in the execution of architectural woodwork, kitchen cabinetry and custom design in general.
about:
Based in Union City, New Jersey, TJ Woodwork Design has spent decades serving designers, architects, contractors, and homeowners with custom architectural woodwork and cabinetry. The company says it brings over 50 years of woodworking experience, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

TJ Woodwork Design provides end-to-end custom woodworking services, from conceptual design and material selection through CAD drafting, in-house fabrication, finishing, and installation. Its workshop produces architectural woodwork, kitchen cabinetry built to Woodwork Institute Custom Grade standards, fiberglass composite countertops with postformed edges, and custom fixtures such as display cases and entertainment centers. All fabrication and finishing occur on site, and installations are performed by company employees without subcontracting.

The firm serves both residential and commercial building sectors, including medical, retail, financial, and public-works projects. Its clients range from general contractors needing made-to-order millwork on tight schedules to cabinetmakers outsourcing cabinet and countertop production, as well as designers and homeowners seeking full design-build solutions.

The company emphasizes that it uses only U.S.-sourced materials, backed by a 100% guarantee, and that keeping every step in house—from design library samples to final installation—allows it to control quality and meet critical deadlines.
